propositions: Fourteen test modules hand-build nested pytest invocations, each re-deciding basetemp, timeout, cache plugin and env, creating duplication and maintenance burden.

Three sites lack --basetemp: test_bare_repository_fixture_portability_heldout.py:25 (executing live integration nodes), test_git_version_floor.py:164 and test_live_jira_xdist_confinement.py:161 (--collect-only children), all instances of a defect root-caused by pytest's cleanup_numbered_dir shutdown timeout.

The helper must forward a caller-supplied env mapping byte-identically with no key added or removed, as four sites deliberately pass minimal two/three-key mappings so pytest's repr cannot truncate security sentinels.

Two sites cannot be converted: test_scripts_import_convention.py:154 and test_tests_import_convention.py:92 launch the bare pytest console script from outside the repo to void sys.path access, so routing through sys.executable -m pytest voids the reproduction.

An AST scan must verify exactly one nested-pytest launch site under tests/ (in the helper itself) and no hand-built launcher blocks elsewhere, since Black formatting splits argv one element per line so source grep passes vacuously.
